definitions.gloss: average score, average mark, mean score
definitions.explanation: The arithmetic mean of test scores or grades. Commonly used in academic contexts to refer to the class or national average on an exam.

examples.japanese: {平均点|へいきんてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧65⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧だった。
⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平均点|へいきんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}かった→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: The average score on this test was low.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均点|へいきんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}った→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was a bit relieved to have scored above the average in math.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧ (average) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point, score). One of the most commonly used academic terms in Japan, where test scores and averages are frequently discussed.

USAGE:
{平均点|へいきんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ means "to get the average score," while {平均点|へいきんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧ / ⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧ means "to score above / below the average."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均点|へいきんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧: to score above average
- {平均点|へいきんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧: to score below average
- {平均点|へいきんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: the average is high
- {平均点|へいきんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: the average is low
- ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均点|へいきんてん}: the class average

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧: average — the general term for average, not limited to scores
- ⟦{偏差値|へんさち}→偏差値：08553_hensachi⟧: standard score, deviation score — a statistical measure widely used in Japanese education to rank students
- ⟦{合格|ごうかく}{点|てん}→合格点：25967_goukakuten⟧: passing score — the minimum score needed to pass
